build_autoencoder_dc: build a python module to instantiate an AutoencoderDC model with custom latent channels and block types
encode_images_with_autoencoder_dc: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the AutoencoderDC encode method
decode_latents_with_autoencoder_dc: decode a batch of latent vectors back to images using the AutoencoderDC decode method
enable_tiled_encoding_autoencoder_dc: enable tiled encoding and decoding on an AutoencoderDC model to process large images with less memory
run_tiled_decode_autoencoder_dc: run tiled decoding on latent tensors using the AutoencoderDC tiled_decode method with custom tile sizes
